text:
It is a matter of words, and yet
neither you nor I
will ever agree, after what has passed,
on who is to blame.

What a pity love has no dictionary
where we might discover
when pride is merely pride
and when it is dignity!

translation.title: Rhyme XXXIII: It Is a Matter of Words...
